component.name: Mixel Remote
component.summary: Remote support and access for your devices

description.p: Connect to your company's computers and phones, or let a technician help on this computer, with consent for every session.
After "Add this computer" no wrong "already registered" message any more. A Mac can be helped from Linux (its picture no longer ends the session); pictures arrive faster.
A slow or late answer to an input or the clipboard no longer ends the session.
Session reports can be exported as PDF. Clipboard, a second technician and switching sides verified between two Linux computers.
The native Linux app (GTK 4 and libadwaita).
